newsitem.title: FRANCE: Malta buys 6,000 tonnes of barley -traders.
newsitem.headline: Malta buys 6,000 tonnes of barley -traders.

text.p: Malta bought 6,000 tonnes of feed barley on Tuesday at a tender for July 25-August 2 delivery, grain traders said.
Unconfirmed trade indications put the price at just under $155 per tonne, cost and freight.
Malta had tendered for the barley in a batch of requests totalling 24,000 tonnes of grain.
Malta sought 3,000 tonnes of optional wheat for July 5-12 arrival, 9,000 tonnes of optional wheat for July 20-30 arrival and 6,000 tonnes of maize for July 25-August 2.
Traders reported some talk that the soft wheat offers had been rejected and Malta would soon tender again for the wheat.
